coreConstraint: Discovery proposes and challenges candidate canonical microwave FUNCTIONS — not OEM component lists. Fit artifacts are immutable input evidence.

immutableFitInputs.policy: Read-only — discovery must not mutate fit closure evidence

notCreating: mutations to any existing frozen canonical ontology

centerpieceQuestion.question: What is the minimum set of canonical microwave FUNCTIONS — not components — that both LG and Samsung diagnostic procedures require?
centerpieceQuestion.framing: Discovery challenges whether triangulation domains become canonical nodes, instance scopes, or conditional layers — and which OEM hardware stays platform-only.
centerpieceQuestion.disallowedShortcut: Promoting every diagnosable component from two manuals into ~30 canonical nodes

candidateFunctionalDomains.discoveryQuestion: Is hv_generation one canonical function with implementation realizations (transformer, capacitor, diode, magnetron, hv_fuse), or multiple functions?
Does door_interlock_chain absorb primary/secondary/monitor/door-sensing as platform vocabulary under one safety function?
Is rf_cavity the abstraction for field uniformity/arcing/waveguide — distinct from hv_generation excitation?
How does thermal_protection represent multi-TCO networks + cabinet thermistor without becoming a component laundry list?
Do humidity and temperature sensing merge into one control_and_sensing function or remain conditional platform scopes?
Is ventilation_otr a conditional function on microwave template only — never merged into range_oven surface_heating_system?

sharedPrerequisiteDomains.note: Superficial overlap with all frozen families — likely prerequisite function not microwave-specific discovery focus
Orchestration function — must not import range_oven heat-path semantics
HMI/service-mode entry — shared pattern across appliances
